intro: Across 16 articles spanning 2026-04-19 to 2026-10-01, ZCyberNews tracks CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog, where government, technology, critical infrastructure, enterprise, and federal government sectors bear the brunt. The United States, Global, North America, EU, and Europe remain the most affected regions. Coverage centers on CVE-2026-20079 and CVE-2026-48907, both rated CVSS 10, alongside CVE-2023-49105, CVE-2025-39682, and CVE-2026-65400 at CVSS 9.8. The severity mix comprises seven critical, four high, and two medium entries.
